name: Update Brief for MainWP
author: David / Update Brief

sections.description:
Update Brief for MainWp is an extension that enhances your client reports with concise update summaries for WordPress plugin updates, and WordPress Core updates.

WordPress developers, agencies, and hosts using these brief update summaries in their client reports, can highlight the importance of their ongoing maintenance and update services.

You can demonstrate the value of these services to your clients, your commitment to website performance and security, and grow your WordPress care and maintenance business with Update Brief for MainWP.

Update Brief for MainWp requires the MainWP Dashboard plugin and MainWP Pro Reports extension.

A subscription is required to access the Update Brief API. There is a 14-day free trial available for all new Update Brief customers.

Update Summaries

The update summaries from Update Brief are a precisely created summary, highlighting the key features of every WordPress core and plugin update, along with any critical security improvements, and significant bug fixes.

Your clients are paying you for ongoing maintenance and update services. Do your current client reports fully demonstrate your value?

Including these update summaries in your client reports will show your clients why these vital updates both improve and secure their website and demonstrate just why an ongoing maintenance and update plan is essential to their success.

External Services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain the brief update summaries for WordPress plugins and core updates. This API connection is required to show the brief update summaries in the MainWP client reports.

For plugin updates, the API request will send the plugin slug, the old and the updated version of the plugin, along with the Update Brief API token.
For WordPress core updates, the API request will send the old and the updated version of WordPress, along with the Update Brief API token.

This service is provided by “UpdateBrief.com”: Terms of Use, Terms of Sale, Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Please install the “MainWP Dashboard” plugin and active it before installing the Update Brief for MainWP plugin
  2. Please install the “MainWP Pro Reports” extension and active it before installing the Update Brief for MainWP plugin
  3. Upload the ‘update-brief-mainwp’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  4. Activate the Update Brief for MainWP plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

A full installation and setup guide can be found on this page, Update Brief for MainWP
sections.faq:
What are update summaries from Update Brief?

Update Brief produces brief update summaries which provide a concise summary of both WordPress Core updates, and WordPress plugin updates.
These easy-to-read brief summaries describe the main features of the updates, with essential information, as well as any security and critical aspects of the update.

Do the update summaries include multiple updates into one summary?

Yes, if you upgrade a plugin from version 1.1.1 to 1.1.5 for example, then then all the main features of all these updates, essential information,
and any security and critical aspects of the updates, will be combined into one easy to read, concise summary.

Are there update summaries available for premium plugins?

Yes, Update Brief does generate brief update summaries for some of the most popular premium plugins available for WordPress.
These premium plugins including Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro, MemberPress, WooCommerce Bookings, WooCommerce Subscriptions, and WP Rocket, as well as many others.
